LanguageData.SSC_MasterQualificationItem.label: Master qualification module
LanguageData.SSC_MasterQualificationItem.description: A data module containing training knowledge and personality certification software. Use it to permanently acquire Master qualification, allowing Master to be selected in the identity menu without automatically changing the current identity. With Royalty, it also supplies any missing techprints for Training; the research must still be completed normally. SSC sex slaves cannot use it, and qualified pawns cannot use another. Qualification travels with personality gel and is not inherited by clones. Successful use consumes one module. Currently appears only as a quest or ancient ruin reward, not in newly generated trader stock.
